_comment: Emergency removal list (D-25) for the atari-st platform. Consumed by tools/build_catalog.py, validated against schema/blacklist.schema.json. Add an object to "blocked" with the app's uuid and the build drops it from atari-st/apps.json, apps-test.json and apps-dev.json alike. One file per platform, all channels, because an app pulled for a defect has to go everywhere at once. Works on the official origin too. It changes the next build only: devices that already downloaded the app keep it. Removing the entry puts the app back, provided its origin still lists it.

_example_blocked_entry._comment: INERT TEMPLATE, kept as documentation rather than as a live entry. build_catalog.py only reads the "blocked" array, so nothing under this key is applied. To pull an app, copy the object below into "blocked" (dropping this "_comment") and put its real uuid in.
_example_blocked_entry.reason: Corrupts the microSD card on STE hardware.
